_note: Energy (sức) of a villager, 0-100. Costs are percentage points. A day's heavy work costs dayCost over the waking hours, a night shift nightCost over the night; jobWeight scales it per job. Sleep gives back sleepNight points over one night of sleep (half that by day) in a Nhà dân; sleepAt scales it by where they lie down: by the campfire (no bed free) it is slower, in the Nhà dân or the Lều chiến binh (soldiers) it is full, and a higher level of the house multiplies it again (its craftSpeed). Below tired a villager must sleep and cannot be woken until wakeAfterTired (wakeAfterCollapse if they fell asleep below collapse). Strain builds up from night work and from collapsing, and wears off with sleep; it lowers the energy ceiling and slows recovery, so nobody can be worked night after night. Night work needs a torch and goes at nightEfficiency.
